title: Business Central AL Customization Project
desc:

Beyond the UI layer, I need business logic that enforces bespoke validation rules and handles data integration processes so information moves reliably between internal modules and any external systems we connect later.  

Additional work will include, when required, adjusting RDLC or Word layouts for reports, extending posting and approval workflows, exposing data through APIs or web services, and tuning SQL for performance.  

Deliverables  
• AL code for tables, pages, and supporting codeunits  
• Implemented validation rules and workflow logic, fully tested  
• Dashboard/report layouts and any modified RDLC/Word files  
• Technical documentation (object list, install steps, test scripts)  
• Source packaged in a Git repository and a compiled extension ready for deployment  

Acceptance Criteria  
• Extension installs without compile warnings or permission errors  
• All test scenarios for data entry, validation, and workflow pass  
• Performance meets current production benchmarks  
• Documentation is clear enough for another developer to maintain  

I will provide functional specs and a sandbox; you return weekly progress updates and commit to the agreed timeline and quality gates.

title: AI Cattle Collar Development
desc:
I need a working prototype of an AI-enabled collar that keeps real-time watch over a cow’s well-being and daily habits. The collar has to:

• Track health by continuously capturing heart rate, temperature and respiration, flagging anomalies for early intervention.  
• Record activity patterns—grazing time, walking distance and rest periods—so I can optimise feed plans and pasture rotation.

I am open to your recommended sensor suite, low-power electronics, edge AI models and a simple companion app or dashboard that turns raw readings into clear, actionable insights. Deliver a fully assembled collar with firmware, data pipeline and a short demo showing the metrics streaming accurately from a live test or simulator.  

If you have previous experience in livestock wearables, embedded ML (TensorFlow Lite, Edge Impulse or similar) and rugged hardware design, I’d like to see it and discuss the timeline to first field trials.

title: Organic Makhana Seasoning Blend
desc:
I need a reliable partner to develop and scale an herbs-and-spices seasoning specifically for makhana snack flavoring. The blend must rely solely on natural, organic ingredients—no synthetics, artificial colors, or anti-caking agents. I already have a taste direction in mind (lightly earthy with a gentle kick), but I am open to your suggestions for achieving a standout profile that will keep consumers reaching for the next handful.

What I expect from you:
• A finished formulation with exact percentages and processing instructions  
• Guidance on sourcing certified-organic raw materials and possible alternate suppliers for cost control  
• A small pilot batch (1–2 kg) for sensory and shelf-life testing  
• Documentation on regulatory compliance and nutritional data suitable for export packaging  
• Clear scale-up notes so the recipe can move straight into commercial production

Experience with snack-food seasonings, spice milling, and organic certification will be valued highly. If you can demonstrate previous results with clean-label products or have access to extrusion/coating equipment for test runs, please mention it in your proposal along with an estimated timeline to first samples.

title: Grow Telegram via Instagram Ads
desc:
I run a Telegram channel for traders and want to fill it with genuinely interested subscribers—not bots or vague “finance” traffic, but people who actively follow trading content. To do this I need a specialist who can plan, launch, and optimise Instagram Explore ads.

You’ll handle the full campaign inside Meta Ads Manager: research the most responsive trading-focused interests, craft creative that speaks to that niche, set up a clear funnel straight to my Telegram link, and keep a close eye on performance so spend translates into quality joins. Story or Feed placements can remain off for now; the push is squarely on Explore where discovery is highest for new audiences.

Please ensure all conversions are real humans. I’ll monitor engagement stats on the channel and will pause the project immediately if artificial traffic appears.

Deliverables:
• Live Explore-placement campaign targeting trading enthusiasts  
• Compelling image or short-form video ads plus copy  
• Daily optimisation and budget pacing  
• Weekly report summarising spend, CPM, CTR, cost-per-join, and overall subscriber growth

Share a quick outline of your approach, any similar Telegram growth results, and the timeframe you expect before the first noticeable bump in subscribers. Let’s drive serious traders into the channel together.

title: Nifty50 Minute OHLC Data -- 2
desc:

I will supply an Excel template that already lists every required timestamp; simply populate the Open, High, Low and Close columns against each row.

Key points

• No extra fields are necessary—just the four price columns.  
• Final delivery should be the same workbook returned to me in .xlsx format, ready for immediate use.

Before we wrap up, I’ll verify the file for missing intervals, incorrect time zones (IST), or obvious outliers. Once everything checks out, the job is complete.

title: Data Cleanup & Web Verification
desc:

Deliverables  
• Cleaned and consolidated customer-info spreadsheet  
• Column-by-column log of any corrections made, including URLs or screenshots that confirm each updated contact detail  
• Final file delivered in Excel and Google Sheets formats, formatted to the provided guidelines  

A sharp eye, solid command of Excel formulas and data-validation tools, plus clear, timely communication are must-haves. If that sounds like you, let’s get started right away.

title: Recover Deleted Camera video
desc:
I pulled a 64 GB SanDisk Ultra microSDXC card from my security camera as soon as I realised the clip I need—recordings from 3 August—had disappeared. Roughly 53 GB of the card was filled when I removed it; the camera routinely overwrites anything older than two days, so at present I can still see 7 and 8 August files, and even some fragments from 6 August when I run Restore My Files. Nothing newer has been written since the card came out of the camera, and there have been no error messages during any attempt so far. Other than Restore My Files, no additional recovery tools have touched the card.

What I need now is an experienced data-recovery specialist who has successfully brought back video from microSD cards used in cameras. The goal is simple: retrieve every playable file from 3 August before any latent data is lost for good.

Deliverable  
• Playable video files (original resolution/format) shot on 3 August.

When you reply, please tell me:  
– Your closest comparable recovery jobs and outcomes.  
– Your estimated probability of success for this case.  
– Your fee structure for both the initial examination and the full recovery.  
– How soon you can start and how long the process is likely to take.

The card is ready to be shipped or imaged as you prefer, and I’ll follow any handling instructions you provide to maximise the chances of full recovery.

title: Accurate Scanned Document Typing
desc:
I will supply a series of scanned images that must be re-typed into clean, editable files. The pages include plenty of numbers as well as text, so precision is critical—every figure has to match the source exactly. A steady typing speed of 35–60 wpm is fine as long as accuracy stays high throughout.  

Microsoft Word and, where tables or calculations appear, Microsoft Excel should be used so the final files mirror the original layout and can be searched, edited, and archived easily.  

Deliverables  
• One properly formatted Word or Excel file for each scanned page  
• Correct spelling, punctuation, and—most importantly—error-free numerical data  
• File names that follow the original document order for straightforward cross-checking  

I will review the work by comparing it against the scans; any discrepancies in numbers or omitted content will need correction before final approval.

title: B2B Telesales Lead Generation
desc:
I need an experienced telesales professional who can pick up the phone, speak confidently with businesses in my chosen regions, and turn cold prospects into warm leads for our digital-marketing and affiliate solutions. The single focus is drumming up new business; every call you place should aim to book a discovery meeting or secure a clear next step with a decision-maker.

You will receive:

• Access to our cloud CRM for logging outcomes.

What I expect from you:

• Daily report of dials, conversations, and scheduled follow-ups.  
• Insightful feedback on objections you encounter so we can fine-tune the pitch.

Acceptance criteria

2. All call outcomes recorded with next action.

If you’re persuasive on the phone, comfortable talking to business owners and marketing managers, and disciplined with CRM notes, let’s talk.

title: Recover 3 Aug & Nearby Recordings
desc:
My security unit overwrites footage after two days, yet I still see traces of 6 August files when I scan the disk (57 GB capacity, 53 GB in use) with “Restore My Files.” This tells me the data from 3 August—and hopefully the neighbouring days—is still lingering in unallocated space.

I need those 3 August recordings brought back and saved directly onto the same device in their original MP4 format. If you can rescue anything just before or after that date as well, even better, but the 3 August material is the priority.

You will have remote or on-site access to the drive image, whichever is safer for data integrity, and I’m happy to create a sector-by-sector clone if you instruct me. Please outline the recovery workflow you intend to follow, the tools you trust (e.g., R-Studio, PhotoRec, GetDataBack, or your own custom scripts), and how you will verify file completeness before handing them over.

Successful delivery means:
• MP4 files from 3 August restored and playable on the device.  
• Any additional footage you can salvage from the surrounding dates placed in a separate folder.  
• A short note on what was recoverable and any sectors that proved unrecoverable.

Let me know your estimated turnaround and any preparatory steps you need from my side.

title: SolidWorks 2D Manufacturing Drawings
desc:

• Translate my hand sketches, photos, or sample components into SolidWorks parts and assemblies, then generate manufacturing-ready SLDDRW files (plus PDF/DXF exports).

title: Social Media Graphics Suite
desc:
I need a fresh, on-brand set of graphics for Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter. The package should cover three formats—standard post images, story-verticals, and ad banners—each optimised to the correct dimensions and file specifications for its platform.

Here is what I’d like delivered:
• Post images (Instagram 1080×1080, Facebook 1200×1200, Twitter 1600×900)  
• Story images (1080×1920 across all three)  
• Ad banners (Facebook & Instagram 1200×628, Twitter 800×418)  
• Editable source files (AI or PSD) plus web-ready PNG/JPEG exports

The look and feel must remain consistent across every asset, reflecting our existing colour palette and typography while still giving each platform its own nuance. Animation isn’t required, but thoughtful use of hierarchy, whitespace, and strong calls-to-action is essential.

I’ll supply our logo, brand colours, and a short creative brief as soon as we begin. Please let me know your estimated turnaround time, how many initial concepts you include, and the number of revisions you’re comfortable offering.

title: Multi-User Algo Trading Setup Integration in AWS
desc:
I have an algo trading system currently running on Delta Exchange for both single-user and multi-user setups. I also have a single-user algo trading system running on Shark Exchange.

I now want to replicate the existing Shark Exchange single-user code into a **multi-user setup**. The complete infrastructure and setup are already running on **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**.

In addition to the multi-user Shark Exchange integration, I need a few minor changes to my website:

* Replace Delta Exchange details with Shark Exchange details in 2–3 places.
* Add a **Forgot Password** functionality.
* Add a **logging system** for the multi-user setup to track user activity, API activity, orders, errors, etc.

The existing system is already functional, so I am primarily looking for someone who can understand the current architecture, replicate the Shark Exchange integration for multiple users, and make the required website changes without affecting the existing Delta Exchange setup.

**Experience with trading APIs, multi-user algo trading systems, AWS, and Shark Exchange API integration is preferred.**

title: Digital Project Scoping Help
desc:
I’m Rahul and I have an idea in mind, but I’m still deciding whether it should become a website, a mobile app, or a design-centric solution. Before any coding or pixel work begins, I need an experienced professional who can sit with me (remotely) and translate the raw concept into a clear, actionable plan.

Here’s what I’m expecting:

• A short discovery call to understand my objectives and target audience  
• Recommendations on the best technical route—web, mobile, or purely graphic—based on effort, cost, and timeline  
• A concise project brief outlining core features, suggested tech stack or design tools, phased milestones, and rough time estimates

If you’re skilled at turning vague ideas into concrete roadmaps and can explain trade-offs in simple language, let’s talk.

title: Sales Focused Email Campaign
desc:
I need an experienced digital marketer who can plan, build, and optimise an email-marketing programme that directly drives revenue. The end goal is simple: measurably boost sales from both existing customers and fresh leads.

Here’s what I have in mind:

• Strategy & segmentation – define clear customer and prospect segments, map touch-points along the buyer journey, and outline frequency, cadence, and offers.  
• Creative & copy – craft attention-grabbing subject lines, persuasive body copy, and strong calls-to-action that speak to repeat buyers as well as people who have never purchased before.  
• Technical setup – build responsive templates in my current ESP (let me know which platforms you excel with), set up automation flows, and ensure deliverability best practices (SPF, DKIM, list hygiene, etc.).  
• Testing & optimisation – run A/B tests on subject lines, send-times, content blocks, and offers; track open, click-through, and conversion metrics; and refine each send based on real-time data.  
• Reporting – provide a concise weekly dashboard showing revenue attributed to the campaign, key engagement KPIs, and actionable recommendations for next steps.

Success for this project will be judged on clear, verifiable increases in sales-per-email-send during the engagement. If you have a proven track record of generating revenue through targeted email sequences, I’d love to hear how you would tackle this brief and what tools or frameworks you’d bring to the table.

title: Service Fee Discrepancy Analysis
desc:
Our transaction ledger hides hundreds of small pricing slips that add up. The job is to surface those slips so the finance team can see exactly where service-level fees drift from policy and how much revenue is at stake.

You will start with raw exports that contain service IDs, transaction dates, listed fees, realised revenue and a few messy quirks—missing cells, outliers and, most of all, inconsistent fee records.  Using Python (Pandas, NumPy) together with SQL for joins and aggregations, clean the data, quantify every charge, and spotlight the inconsistencies.

Deliverables  
• Tidy dataset with documented cleaning steps  
• Jupyter notebook (reproducible, well-commented) plus separate .sql files for any queries  
• Statistical profile for each service: average fee, variance, revenue share and count of suspect transactions  
• Flag on every row that breaks the expected fee range, plus a ranked list of the worst offenders  
• Clear visualisations—histograms, box plots, heat maps—that drop straight into a finance deck  
• Short narrative report outlining method, insights and optimisation suggestions  

Acceptance criteria  
• Code runs end-to-end on our sample without manual tweaks  
• Inconsistency flagging shows at least 95 % accuracy on a spot-checked subset  
• All figures reconcile with the summary statistics you provide  

If pricing audits and data hygiene are your comfort zone, let’s turn our fee structure into a well-oiled revenue engine.

title: AI Cartoon Videos & Images
desc:
I want to create a small collection of AI-generated media that mixes fun cartoon-style motion with still imagery. Specifically, I need a set of short animated videos produced in a clear, engaging Cartoon/Animation style, along with a batch of still pictures—split between portrait shots and scenic landscape compositions.  

You’re free to choose the AI tools you’re most comfortable with (Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, Runway, DALL-E, or similar), as long as the final files arrive in high-resolution formats ready for immediate use on social channels.  

Deliverables  
• 4–6 short cartoon animations (≈15–30 sec each, MP4 or MOV)  
• 8–10 AI-generated portraits (PNG/JPEG, 4K preferred)  
• 8–10 AI-generated landscapes (PNG/JPEG, 4K preferred)  

Please let me know your typical turnaround time and any examples of similar AI artwork you’ve produced so I can get a feel for your style before we begin.

title: TikTok Vertical AI Drama Series
desc:
I’m producing a 30-episode vertical drama built for TikTok’s algorithm: two-minute chapters, 9:16 aspect ratio, ultra-realistic visuals, and seamless AI generation through Seedance. The core vibe is dark, gritty, and relentlessly intense—an action story layered with fantasy and thriller elements that centres on anti-heroes and outright villains rather than traditional saviours.

Every episode must hook viewers in the first three seconds, sustain momentum with sharp pacing, and close on a cliff-hanger that drives re-watchs and shares. High-fidelity graphics are non-negotiable; I’m looking for near-cinematic quality despite the short form. Dialogue, animated movement, lighting, and atmospheric sound design all need to feel as if they were shot on location in a big-budget production, only delivered through AI.

Seedance will be the production backbone, so you should already be comfortable prompting, refining, and compositing with it. If you like to mix in tools such as Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, or Runway, great—as long as Seedance remains the central pipeline. Final masters must be ready for immediate upload to TikTok, complete with hard-coded captions, dynamic text where relevant, and algorithm-friendly metadata.

Deliverables  
• 30 vertical episodes, 2:00 each (±5 s)  
• Seedance project files and any supporting assets  
• SRT or burned-in captions matching dialogue  
• One-sentence hook and hashtag set per episode  
• Style guide so future seasons can maintain continuity

title: Native-Sounding English Speaker to Record Himself Taking an AI Interview
desc:
I am producing a short demo video for an AI-powered career platform. The product is an AI interview simulator - a real-time voice interview where an AI interviewer asks adaptive questions and then scores the candidate.

I need one person to BE the candidate in that interview, and to record it themselves at home.

This is not a voiceover reading job. There is no script. You log into an account I provide and take a real AI voice interview. The AI asks unpredictable follow-up questions, so you need to think and speak naturally for about 8-10 minutes per run.

You will answer as YOURSELF, using your own real work experience - so there is nothing to memorise and nothing to invent. What you send me beforehand is an ANONYMISED version of your own CV:
- Replace your name with any name you like
- Replace every employer with a fictional company name
- Shift or generalise dates, and remove city, address, phone, email and links
- Rename or generalise any distinctive project, product or client name that could identify you or a former employer
- Keep the roles, responsibilities, skills and achievements real, so your answers are genuine

The anonymised CV appears on screen in the video, so nothing in it may be traceable back to you or to a real company. I will delete the file once the video is finished.

I will share the product name, the account and the full brief with the freelancer I award. Please do not ask for these details in your proposal.

WHAT YOU DELIVER
- Your anonymised CV, sent

title: Engaging Social Media Graphic Set
desc:
I need a cohesive batch of fresh, scroll-stopping visuals tailored for Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. The goal is to keep our look consistent across the three feeds while allowing each platform’s dimensions and best practices to shine.

Here’s what I’m after:
• A branded template style I can reuse, plus a first wave of finished posts (static or short animated loops—whichever you recommend for reach and engagement on each channel).  
• Correct sizing for all three platforms so nothing gets cropped.  
• Editable source files (PSD, AI, or layered Canva links) alongside ready-to-post PNG/MP4 exports.

I’ll supply the logo, palette, copy lines, and any product shots the moment we start. You’ll bring the typography, layout sense, and that extra polish that makes someone pause their scroll.

Deliverables are approved once the files render crisply on each platform, colors match the brand values I provide, and text remains legible on mobile. Let me know your typical turnaround and how many revision rounds you include so we can lock the schedule right away.

title: Digital Product Sales Funnel
desc:
I need a single-page sales funnel built from the ground up that turns cold traffic into paid customers for the digital products I promote through affiliate marketing. The primary metric for success is sales conversion, so every element must work together to move visitors from curiosity to checkout without friction.

Here’s what I expect:
• A persuasive, benefit-driven layout with engaging copy, clear value propositions, and bold call-to-action sections aimed squarely at purchasing.  
• Responsive design that looks sharp on mobile and desktop, created in a mainstream funnel tool such as ClickFunnels, Elementor, Leadpages, or a comparable builder you’re comfortable with.  
• Seamless integration of payment processing and tracking pixels so I can monitor conversions inside Facebook Ads, Google Analytics, and my affiliate dashboard.  
• Delivery of all working files plus a hand-off video or short loom showing me how to tweak headlines, pricing blocks, or images in the future.

Acceptance criteria: the page loads in under three seconds, displays correctly across modern browsers, and achieves an initial test conversion rate of at least 3% from a sample of 100 visitors once live tracking is enabled.

If you have a portfolio of high-converting digital product funnels, share it so I can see your style in action.

title: Revise Permit Set Per City Feedback
desc:
The city has returned my plans with a short list of comments and I need the full permit set revised so it sails through re-submittal.  

Scope of work  
• Written content – Update every description, keynote and general note called out in the plans, incorporate the new compliance statements, and refresh the material specifications exactly as red-lined by the reviewer.  
• Site plan – Insert a clear, scaled site plan that meets the latest submittal standards.  
• Code check – Verify the entire set against the current code year the city is enforcing and flag any additional tweaks I may have missed.  
• Electrical – Adjust the drawings only for wiring modifications; no outlet layout changes or panel upgrades are required.  

Deliverables  
1. PDF and original CAD of the revised permit set, including the new site plan.  
2. A concise change log referencing the city comment numbers so the reviewer can see how each note was addressed.  

I will consider the job complete when the document set is ready for immediate re-upload to the city portal and all comments tied to written text, wiring modifications, and code year have been fully resolved.

title: Optimize Baileys WhatsApp Web
desc:
My Baileys-based WhatsApp integration is working, but it is starting to lag under heavier traffic. I need an experienced developer who knows the Baileys library inside out to:

• Profile the current code, identify the CPU, memory and I/O bottlenecks, and refactor or re-architect where necessary to improve throughput and lower latency.  
• Verify that every optimised change remains fully compatible with the Web version of WhatsApp, including session handling, QR login, message sending/receiving, media uploads and reconnection logic.  
• Provide a concise report of the issues discovered, the steps taken to fix them and before-and-after performance metrics (e.g. average response time, messages per second, memory footprint).

Acceptance criteria  
– Messages and media must send and arrive in under two seconds in a sustained test with at least 200 concurrent conversations.  
– No functional regressions when accessed exclusively through WhatsApp Web.  
– Clear documentation and commented code so future maintenance is straightforward.

You will have direct access to the current repository and a staging server for load testing. I can spin up extra test nodes or supply sample data if needed. Once optimisation and compatibility checks are complete, we will run a final stress test together before sign-off.

title: Scientific Nutrition Advice Article
desc:
I’m looking for a writer who can craft a well-researched, scientifically grounded article that delivers practical nutritional advice. The piece should translate current research into clear, actionable guidance that an educated lay reader can trust.

Scope  
• Format: 1,200–1,500 words, Microsoft Word or Google Docs  
• Tone: scientific and informative—evidence first, jargon explained plainly  
• Focus: nutritional advice supported by recent, reputable studies (preferably within the last five years)  
• Structure: engaging introduction, logical sub-headings, concise takeaway section, full reference list in APA style  
• Originality: 100 % plagiarism-free, properly cited data and quotations

What I’ll review  
1. Depth and accuracy of research  
2. Clarity of explanations for non-specialist readers  
3. Smooth flow and professional grammar  
4. Correct citation and formatting

Please include a short note on your experience with nutrition writing and one sample of a similar science-oriented piece when you apply. I prioritise accuracy, punctual delivery, and overall quality, and I’m ready to move quickly once the right freelancer is found.

title: Tally Prime Data Entry and Validation
desc:
All sales invoices, purchase bills, and daily bank transactions from the current quarter have to be entered directly into my existing Tally Prime company file. The ledgers are already created; what’s missing is the careful voucher posting that keeps the GST, narrations, and cost-centre tags consistent with my past records.

Once the entries are in, I will generate the financial statements myself, so the core of this job is accurate, audit-ready data entry. If you notice a mismatch while posting—say, an invoice total that doesn’t agree with its payment—flag it straight away so we can correct it on the spot. Although my immediate need is data entry, experience with reconciliation or report generation in Tally Prime will be appreciated, as I may extend the work later.

Deliverables:
• Clean, validated voucher entries for sales, purchases, and bank transactions in my live Tally Prime file
• A brief summary of any discrepancies or missing paperwork discovered during posting

Successful completion will be confirmed once every document I provide appears in Tally Prime with matching values and dates, and no suspense entries remain.

title: Comprehensive PLS-CADD Project Execution
desc:
I’m looking for a seasoned PLS-CADD specialist who can carry a transmission-line assignment from the first data check right through to the final design package. I already hold partial survey and structure data, yet it is dated and needs a careful review before any modelling begins. From that point onward, I need the full line model built, every structure analysed for strength and clearance, and a clean set of design reports generated for engineering sign-off and construction use.

You will work directly in PLS-CADD (and, where helpful, PLS-POLE or PLS-Tower) to:
• verify and update the existing centre-line, LiDAR and structure library;
• model the complete route, conductor and hardware;
• run sag-tension, loading and clearance checks;
• perform structure capacity and interaction analysis; and
• output the full suite of standard PLS-CADD reports as well as any custom summaries I may request.

Deliverables
• Updated project database and all native PLS-CADD files  
• Finalised line model reflecting verified field data  
• Structural and clearance analysis output (PDF and original REP files)  
• Consolidated design / construction report bundle  
• Short handover note describing assumptions, versions and key settings  

Acceptance
The job is complete once the files open without errors in PLS-CADD, all clearances and loading factors meet governing code limits, and the reports match the final model. If you can collaborate over a brief screen-share to walk me through your file set be

title: AI-Generated Viral Shorts -- 2
desc:
I’m building an ongoing catalogue of 30- to 60-second entertainment pieces that will debut first on YouTube Shorts and later be repurposed for Instagram Reels and TikTok. Each clip must feel as if it was shot on a real set: believable lighting, natural motion, and zero uncanny-valley giveaways.  

Here’s the flow I’m after. I give you a prompt or micro-script; you run it through your preferred generative platform—Runway, Pika, Kling, Veo, or any comparable tool—to craft realistic or cinematic visuals. You layer an English or Hindi AI voice-over that sounds human, weave in caption graphics that match the beat, add smooth transitions, and finish with royalty-free background music. The final render comes back to me in crisp 1080p, ready for immediate upload.  

Because shorts move fast, I need someone who can turn around multiple videos a week without sacrificing polish. When you reply, link to a few AI-generated samples that show the realism you can achieve and let me know which tools are in your current toolkit. If you can meet rapid deadlines, maintain consistent quality, and keep audiences hooked in the first three seconds, we’ll be working together for the long haul.

title: Architectural Thesis 3D Modeling Support
desc:
I’m advancing my architectural thesis and need a skilled hand to turn my concept drawings into accurate, presentation-ready 3D models. The core of the assignment is modelling; I already have 2D plans in AutoCAD, and I’d like the workflow to start from those files. You can choose the modelling environment you’re most comfortable with—Revit, SketchUp, or any other professional tool—as long as the geometry stays true to the CAD base and the exported results (renders, walkthroughs, or orthographic views) integrate cleanly back into AutoCAD sheets.

There’s no strict deadline, so we can prioritise precision and iterative feedback over speed. Along the way, I may ask for occasional Photoshop or Canva touch-ups for board layouts, but the primary deliverable remains a fully detailed, well-textured 3D model that convincingly communicates form, materiality, and spatial quality.

To make sure we stay aligned, please be ready to:

• import my .dwg set and confirm dimensions  
• build the massing, structure, and key interior elements in 3D  
• add realistic materials, lighting, and entourage suitable for studio juries  
• hand over native model files plus high-resolution renders and any supplemental graphics

If that scope fits your expertise in AutoCAD-driven modelling, I’d love to collaborate, review progress in stages, and produce a thesis package that stands out.

title: ESP8266 Bidirectional IR Control
desc:
I need robust, well-documented firmware that lets an ESP8266 on the Arduino platform both send and receive infrared commands for multiple air-conditioner remotes. Serial command-line interaction over USB or Telnet is all that’s required; no web or mobile interface is necessary.  

Core tasks  
• Build or adapt an Arduino-compatible sketch that scans incoming IR frames, decodes them, and logs the raw timing as well as the decoded protocol and data.  
• Implement a complementary routine that allows me to replay captured frames or craft new ones from the command line, then transmit them through an IR LED with correct carrier frequency and timing precision.  
• Structure the code so adding or tweaking protocols is straightforward—I will be experimenting with a variety of AC brands.  

Environment & tools  
Arduino IDE or PlatformIO, Espressif SDKs, and the popular IRremote(ESP8266) libraries are all acceptable as long as any third-party code is cited.  

Deliverables  
1. Complete, compile-ready sketch (.ino or PlatformIO project) with clear pin assignments for IR LED and receiver diode.  
2. Simple serial command set (e.g., CAPTURE, PLAY <hex>, SAVE <name>, LOAD <name>) described in a README.  
3. Instructions for wiring, library installation, and testing on a NodeMCU or similar ESP8266 board.  
4. A brief video or screenshot proof showing a capture-and-replay cycle controlling an AC unit.  

I’ll flash and bench-test the code on my hardware; payment releases once the same captu

title: GST Practitioner , INDIAN C.A  OR Experienced GST EXPERT FOR REFUND Needed for Inverted Duty Structure Refund Filing
desc:
Job Title: GST Practitioner OR Experienced GST EXPERT FOR REFUND Needed for Inverted Duty Structure Refund Filing
Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) or GST Expert to help us claim and process our accumulated GST refund due to an inverted duty structure (where the tax rate on inputs is higher than the tax rate on outward supplies).

Key Responsibilities:

Analyze our purchase and sales data to verify input tax credit (ITC) accumulation.

Prepare and file the GST refund application (RFD-01) on the GST portal.

Respond to any Notices or Deficiency Memos issued by the GST department.

Coordinate the end-to-end refund process until the amount is successfully credited.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Proven experience in filing GST refunds, specifically for inverted duty structures.

In-depth knowledge of GST laws, rules, and documentation requirements.

Familiarity with the Indian GST portal and communication with tax authorities.

title: Material Enrichment Processing Setup
desc:
I’m upgrading a material-enrichment line that includes tag extraction, floc separation and a draft bill of materials. The immediate goal is to translate what I already have into a fully workable enrichment process: confirm the flow, size and specify each piece of equipment, and document operating parameters so procurement and commissioning can begin right away.

You will:
• Validate and optimise the enrichment stage, integrating tag-extraction and floc-handling steps.
• Deliver a process flow diagram, refined equipment list/BOM and concise operating guidelines suitable for hand-off to my purchasing team.

I’m moving fast, so only reply if you can start immediately. Point me to past work on comparable enrichment or separation systems—those references will decide the shortlist.

title: Creative Tech Article Writing Required
desc:
Hi there,

I would love to write a well-structured, engaging, and 100% original 500-word article on a current technology topic like AI, Blockchain, or IoT.

As a passionate creative writer and poet, I bring a unique ability to blend deep emotion and flow with technical accuracy. I excel at simplifying complex concepts into smooth, reader-friendly prose without overwhelming your audience with unnecessary technical jargon.

Here is what you will receive with my delivery:

Word Count: 480–520 words of completely original content tailored for a broad readership.

Flawless Quality: Solid structure, correct grammar, precise punctuation, and short readable paragraphs.

Deliverables: Fully proofread article in editable Google Docs / Word format.

Authenticity Proof: A brief plagiarism/originality report (Turnitin/Copyscape screenshot) ensuring 100% unique work.

I am ready to start immediately and can deliver the final, polished piece within 24 hours. Looking forward to your response!

Best regards,

Sukriti Shrivastava

title: Daily International News Article Writer
desc:
I need a dependable English-language journalist who can file one well-sourced international news story every day. Each piece must track major developments in politics, business, and health from across the globe and present them in a clear, impartial, formal tone that would be at home in a traditional broadsheet.

To succeed you will be comfortable scanning wires, reputable outlets, research papers, and official releases, then distilling the key facts into concise copy that avoids opinion. Accuracy, proper attribution, and up-to-the-minute relevance are essential.

Deliverables  
• One original international news article per calendar day (750-1,000 words, submitted as a Word or Google Doc)  
• Headline, sub-headline, and two-sentence summary for quick syndication  
• Source list with links for every fact or quotation  

Acceptance Criteria  
• Factual accuracy and neutrality; no AI-generated or plagiarised text  
• Written in formal journalistic English, free of grammatical errors  
• Delivered by 18:00 GMT each day  

If you have a background in newsroom reporting or wire-service writing, I’d love to see recent clips when you bid.

title: Custom 4-Week Weight-Loss Plan
desc:
I’m putting together a results-driven, 4-week programme focused squarely on fat loss. The plan has to weave together nutrition, strength work, cardio and detailed progress tracking so I can see exactly what is (and isn’t) working.

Nutrition  
• Provide a day-by-day meal plan organised by calories per meal, with clear portion sizes plus full macro breakdowns.  
• Include a weekly grocery list and quick meal-prep pointers so everything fits a hectic schedule and a normal kitchen.

Training  
• Design a progressive gym routine covering four weeks: sets, reps, rest times and the specific cardio work that complements the strength sessions.  
• Keep each workout efficient—ideal for a busy adult with standard commercial-gym equipment.

Tracking Tools  
• Build editable Excel and Google Sheets templates that log weight, girth measurements, body-fat estimates and workout performance.  
• Export polished, print-ready PDF versions of the same sheets.

Personalisation  
Once I share my age, height, weight, activity level, food preferences, allergies and any training limitations, I’ll need you to tighten the plan so it’s truly tailored.

To be considered, demonstrate relevant experience creating similar fat-loss programmes and any skills with spreadsheet or nutrition-tracking tools. If you have sample plans or templates (with client details removed), feel free to reference them; that will help me judge fit quickly.

Deliver everything in editable formats and PDFs, ready for immediate use

title: Supplier/Manufacturer Research & Negotiation Expert

title: Travel Booking & Invoicing MVP
desc:
I'm seeking a developer to create a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a Travel Booking and Invoicing system. This platform will primarily manage car rental bookings and generate PDF invoices.

title: College Residential Design Assessment
desc:
I have a pending internal assessment for my architecture course that focuses on a residential building design, and I need it completed to submission standard. All university rubrics demand a coherent concept narrative supported by correctly scaled drawings, clear annotations, and presentation material that communicates spatial quality and technical viability.

Here is what I already have: a rough concept brief, site photographs, and basic zoning information. What I still need is the full package—plans, sections, elevations, and visually engaging material such as a 3D massing model or renders—laid out into an A2 board format ready for printing and a separate PDF for digital upload.  

I am open to whichever workflow you prefer: AutoCAD or Revit for 2D drawings, SketchUp, Rhino, or similar for quick volumes, and Lumion, Enscape, or V-Ray if you choose to produce photorealistic shots. The key is that the output must align with typical academic grading criteria: consistent graphic language, line-weight hierarchy, north arrows, scale bars, and concise text blocks explaining design intent.

Timeline is tight—one week from acceptance—so clear milestones for concept refinement, draft drawings, and final presentation will help us both stay on track. If you have experience turning student concepts into polished academic submissions, I’d love to see a portfolio sample before we start.

title: Mobile Banking Education & Lead-Gen App
desc:
Financial Literacy & Lead-Generation App — Project Description

Overview
We are building a mobile-friendly application for a bank that helps everyday users understand insurance products and other financial instruments (savings, investment, and protection products) in a simple, friendly, and multilingual way. The app is educational and lead-focused: users learn about products, get their questions answered by an AI assistant, and can submit an enquiry that is routed to the bank's sales/agent team for follow-up. This is a non-transactional platform — no purchases, payments, or account opening in this phase.

Goal
Improve financial literacy, present the bank's products in an accessible format, and generate qualified leads — while giving the bank full control to manage content and products themselves, without needing a developer for every change.

Key Features

Educational content organised by topic/category (insurance, savings, investments), with rich formatting, search, and FAQs.
Product catalogue with detail pages (description, key features, eligibility, benefits) and a simple side-by-side comparison view.
Multilingual experience — user-selectable language; start with 1–2 languages, expandable later. All content and UI text must be translatable.
AI chatbot / virtual assistant that any user (including guests) can use to ask questions in natural language and be guided to the right content or product. The chatbot must be grounded in the bank's approved content only — no fabricated

title: Professional Website Development for ICD Cargo Movers
desc:
ICD Cargo Movers seeks an experienced web developer to design and develop a professional, responsive, and user-friendly website. The website will highlight our expertise in heavy cargo, project cargo, container transportation, and specialized logistics services across India. Key features include: 
- Pages: Home, About Us (Vision, Mission, Values), Services, Fleet, Industries We Serve, Safety, Contact Us.  
- Interactive Elements: Enquiry form with fields like Name, Company Name, Mobile Number, Email, Pickup/Delivery Location, Cargo Type, Weight, Vehicle Requirement.  
- Design Requirements: Modern layout with premium visuals of fleet operations and seamless navigation.  
- Header & Footer: Includes logo placement, quick links to pages, contact details, and a "Get a Quote" button.

Die vorhandene Drehplattform erfüllt grundsätzlich die Anforderungen hinsichtlich Antrieb und Positionierung. Das Problem ist jedoch die Belastbarkeit bzw. Steifigkeit gegenüber Kippmomenten, da an der Abtriebsseite eine außermittige mechanische Belastung auftritt.

Dabei soll nach Möglichkeit die vorhandene HRP130 als Getriebe- und Antriebseinheit weiterverwendet werden. Denkbar wäre beispielsweise eine zusätzliche Lagerung der Abtriebsseite. Andere technisch sinnvolle Lösungen sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

VORHANDENE KOMPONENTEN
> Hohlwellen-Drehplattform: HRP130KK-G10-D14
> Übersetzungsverhältnis: 10:1
> Vorhandener Servomotor: MOONS' SM3L-062AXNPV
> Der vorhandene Servomotor soll in die neue Konstruktion integriert werden.
Die technischen Zeichnungen und STEP-Dateien beider Komponenten werden zur Verfügung gestellt.
Die HRP130 besitzt laut Hersteller ein zulässiges Ausgangsdrehmoment von 32 Nm, eine empfohlene Axiallast von 250 N und eine maximale Axiallast von 2.000 N.

用AI起草活动通知、主持词、新闻稿

向会长同步关键节点进展

手持流程表，负责全场调度

透明财务：每个项目开始前共同确定预算，结束后一起算账，公开透明
阶梯分成：项目利润越高，你的分成比例越高，上不封顶
按项目结算：一个项目一结，周期短、回款快
灵活时间：绝大部分工作在线上完成，不坐班、不打卡
五、你需要是这样的人

年龄不是问题，28-45岁可能比较合适（但不绝对）
靠谱、有闭环：交代的事，有交代、有回应、有结果
眼里有活：不是等派活，而是主动想“这事我能不能帮上忙”
沟通舒服：能跟阿姨们好好说话，也能跟会长高效同步信息

The work may include:

* Analysis and ranking of SCM delay factors
* Identification of relevant factors for simulation
* Development of a suitable construction project schedule/model
* Conversion of delay factors into simulation inputs
* Monte Carlo Schedule Risk Simulation
* P50, P80 and P90 completion-date analysis
* Sensitivity/tornado analysis
* Scenario analysis, where appropriate
* Tables, graphs and interpretation of results
* Clear documentation of the methodology and results

The analysis should be based on the actual survey data provided. **No fabricated data should be used.**

Please include your relevant experience, proposed methodology, software/tools you will use, estimated timeline, and total quotation.

**Budget: ₹10,000–₹20,000**

title: STM32 Real-Time Audio DSP & PCB -- 2
desc:
I’m building a self-contained DJ-style effects controller that lives entirely on an STM32 with its on-chip ADC/DAC. The unit must stream stereo audio, generate notes, and manipulate that signal on the fly. I already have a rough hardware concept; what I’m missing is the specialist who can marry fierce real-time DSP with a production-ready board.

Here’s the core of what you’ll tackle: the firmware must deliver reverb, delay and distortion simultaneously, reacting to automated real-time parameter changes rather than simple on/off triggers. Latency has to stay imperceptible and all processing must run directly on the MCU (no external DSP). I’d like the algorithms written in C/C++ using STM32CubeIDE and, where helpful, CMSIS-DSP or ARM’s Hel libraries, but I’m open to other toolchains if you can justify the benefit.

On the hardware side you’ll refine my schematic, choose the right codec front-end, lay out a clean, low-noise PCB and supply full production files—schematic, layout, GERBERs, BOM and assembly notes. Careful grounding, power-rail filtering and analogue stage placement are essential so the effects you code aren’t masked by hiss or hum.

Deliverables  
• Compilable STM32 firmware with reverb, delay and distortion engines, each supporting parameter automation  
• All project source, documented for future feature additions  
• Complete PCB design package ready for fabrication and assembly  
• A brief test report demonstrating effect quality, CPU load and measured audio l

Acceptance criteria  
1. Research gap is explicitly articulated and supported by citations.  
2. Each case study is anonymised or referenced with permission, includes project scale, BIM tools used (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, CostX), and documented cost performance.

4. One 1-litre pilot batch (or concentrate with reconstitution guide) shipped to my address

The visuals should rely primarily on bar charts so that trends and comparisons are instantly clear. Please add slicer or timeline filters so I can toggle months, products, and regions without touching the underlying data. I also need a concise monthly summary sheet that pulls key KPIs straight from the pivots.

Deliverables
• Dynamic pivot tables for Product, Month, and Region (India)  
• Bar-chart driven dashboard with interactive filters

title: Hotel Wi-Fi AAA & Portal
desc:
I’m putting together a full, cloud-based AAA/RADIUS and Captive Portal package for a hotel group that wants to elevate the guest Wi-Fi experience. The end result must let a guest unlock internet access automatically through their room record while still giving us the marketing and operational tools we need. 

Core objectives
• A friction-less, room-based login flow that pulls credentials in real time from the Property Management System (PMS) via API.  
• Cloud AAA/RADIUS handling both authentication and accounting, with VLAN or bandwidth profiles assigned per room or guest type.  
• A Captive Portal that supports custom branding, social-media login, and rich data collection/analytics, all tied back to the AAA engine.  

Scope of work
1. Solution design: choose the cloud platform, size the RADIUS cluster, map VLANs and SSIDs, outline the PMS middleware, and document every flow.  
2. Build & configure: stand up the cloud AAA/RADIUS instance, deploy the branded portal pages, connect the PMS API, and integrate with the existing access points.  
3. Testing & validation: simulate guest check-in/out, stress-test concurrent sessions, verify accounting records, and ensure the portal behaves on all major devices.  
4. Deployment & cut-over: migrate live traffic, monitor for issues, fine-tune policies, and hand over full documentation.  
5. Support & training: provide post-launch support plus administrator training so in-house staff can manage policies and view analytics.  

Deliverable

We’re looking for a **manual QA freelancer with bookkeeping/accounting knowledge** to help test our accounting software on each release.

This is **not an automation testing role**.

You will follow a fixed test checklist, upload our test documents, review the results in our web app, and then verify the final accounting result inside **AutoCount** using a remote Windows machine we provide.

## What you’ll do

For each release cycle, you will:

* Run a fixed regression checklist provided by us
* Upload and process test invoices/receipts
* Review the results in our web app
* Verify the resulting accounting entries in AutoCount
* Check items such as:

  * Purchase Invoice / Payment Voucher type
  * account codes
  * amounts
  * invoice dates
  * project / department codes where applicable
* Test one mobile capture flow on a real phone
* Mark every test as PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED
* Provide screenshots and exact reproduction steps for every failure

Each cycle should take around **2–3 hours**.

We expect the completed report within **24 hours** after receiving the test pack.

## What we provide

You do **not** need your own AutoCount licence.

We provide:

* test documents
* answer key
* regression checklist
* report template
* staging account
* remote Windows QA machine with AutoCount
* clear instructions for every test

You will only work with our QA data. No customer accounting books are involved.

• Accurate depiction of current flood spread, using my supplied imagery as the base layer  
• Dynamic overlays that reveal gate operations, pipeline paths, flow direction, and volume changes in real time  
• Visual clarification of benefits to communities and farmland once water reaches drought areas  

I expect cinematic yet factual motion graphics, smooth camera moves, clear typography for labels, and a cohesive colour palette that distinguishes flooded, transit, and revitalised zones. Industry-standard tools such as After Effects, Element 3D, Cinema 4D, or Houdini for fluid simulations are welcome—as long as the final render feels authentic.
